Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: This is a glycan-centric footprinting study rather than a standard protein proteomics experiment. The 'Targeted' acquisition refers to the targeted MS2 scans for specific glycan masses. The modifications are non-standard (CF3 and OH radicals) used for structural probing.

scope: Here, we report the footprinting of a model trisaccharide, triacetylchitotriose (NAG3)
A glycan mixture containing 25 μM each of NAG3, isomaltotriose, 1-kestose, raffinose, and melezitose was prepared in 10 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 7.4).
Four proteins were evaluated in this study, comprising two non-carbohydrate-binding proteins (ubiquitin and myoglobin) and two carbohydrate-binding proteins (lysozyme and lectin).
The NAG3 samples were oxidized by hydroxyl radicals using laser and FOX intrument was used for NAG3 oxidation by CF3 radicals.
